subject: Acme procurement readiness / commercial path
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 15:10:00 -0500
Subject: Acme procurement readiness / next steps

Hi Samantha —

Great to speak earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can unblock procurement:

- Recap: Acme is interested in Redwood Dedicated for predictable throughput; priority is POC -> reserved capacity for Q1.
- Commercial path question: Are you planning to buy via PO (vendor setup) or a corporate card / procurement card?
- Marketplace interest: Do you need an AWS Marketplace listing for procurement to move faster? We can provide marketplace options but it adds a couple weeks for onboarding.

Attachments: redwood-pricing-sheet.xlsx (pricing tiers), redwood-sow-acme.pdf (draft SOW)

Proposed next steps:
1) If PO path: share vendor setup form and invoicing details (term preferences: Net30/Net45).
2) If card/marketplace: confirm payment method and team to run vendor onboarding.
3) I can schedule a 30-min call with our finance/ops (Connor) to walk procurement through vendor information — would Thursday or Friday work?

Thanks — happy to adjust based on what you need to get the PO moving.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0198

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@acme.com>, procurement@acme.com
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Acme procurement readiness / next steps

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the recap. A few updates from our side:

- Procurement is the blocking piece right now. Tom is leading but is out for a couple days; procurement@acme.com owns vendor setup.
- We're leaning toward PO (vendor setup + Net30). Procurement will need a completed vendor form, W-9, and an invoice example.
- Regarding AWS Marketplace: procurement prefers direct PO for our legal and invoicing audits, but if Redwood already has an AWS Marketplace listing that might simplify some of the approvals. Can you confirm whether Redwood is on AWS Marketplace and if so, what the billing flow would look like?

I'll loop in procurement formally once Tom returns on Friday. Can you send the vendor form and a short vendor info packet? Also confirm the invoicing email and remittance address you prefer.

Cheers,
Samantha Lee
Sr. Product Manager, AI Platform | Acme Corp
samantha.lee@acme.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Acme procurement readiness / next steps

Hi Samantha —

Thanks — attaching a completed vendor packet and an invoice example for Acme's procurement team.

Quick answers:
- Redwood is available on AWS Marketplace in most regions; however, Marketplace purchases route through AWS and can change invoicing cadence. If Acme requires Net30 directly to Redwood, PO+vendor setup is the fastest path to preserve Net30 terms.
- Attached: redwood-pricing-sheet.xlsx (updated), redwood-sow-acme.pdf (marked for SOW redlines), acme-vendor-form.pdf (filled).

Connor (cc'd) can join a 20–30 min call with procurement to run through the vendor setup and invoice process — Connor, are you available Friday at 11am PT?

If procurement wants DocuSign for the SOW we can send a DocuSign link; otherwise we can accept a signed PDF and a PO + vendor setup.

Best,
Marissa

Attachments: redwood-pricing-sheet.xlsx, redwood-sow-acme.pdf, acme-vendor-form.pdf

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@acme.com, Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Acme procurement readiness / next steps

Marissa —

Quick procurement update:

- Procurement is leaning toward PO (Net30). They need vendor W-9 (received) and the filled vendor form (we got your packet). Next step: vendor setup ticket in our systems — that usually takes about 7–10 business days once opened.
- The sticky item is invoice remittance details and whether Redwood can accept standard Acme terms (Net30, electronic invoicing).
- Marketplace: procurement says AWS Marketplace would shorten vendor approvals but we need confirmation on invoicing alignment. If Redwood can do Net30 via Marketplace or provide 3rd-party billing details, that would be ideal.

Attaching the procurement intake form they returned (procurement filled some fields). We'll open a vendor ticket Friday when Tom is back. Can you confirm the remittance address and the vendor contact (for vendor setup)? Also, if you have an FAQ for marketplace billing, please share.

Thanks,
Samantha

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 10:22:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Acme procurement readiness / next steps (weekly check-in)

Hi Samantha —

Appreciate the update. Quick answers to unblock procurement:

- Remittance: Redwood Inference, Attn: Finance — finance@redwoodinference.com — 450 Market St, Suite 200, San Francisco, CA 94105. We accept electronic invoicing and Net30.
- Vendor contact for setup: finance@redwoodinference.com (primary), accounts@redwoodinference.com (backup).
- Marketplace FAQ: https://docs.redwoodinference.com/marketplace-billing (short overview) and I can pull Connor in for a 15-min call to explain differences.

If procurement will open the vendor ticket on Friday, that timeline (7–10 business days) should get you vendor setup by end of month. Let me know if you'd like us to fill any additional internal fields on the procurement intake form.

I'll follow up Friday to see where it's stuck — happy to surface any items to my finance ops partner to accelerate. HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567890

Best,
Marissa
